title: GetIt - Day & Meal Planner
short_description: Plan your day, meals and shopping on one page. Works offline, syncs everywhere.
full_description:
GetIt keeps your day on one page. Tasks sit on a time rail down the margin, the way you would write them in a notebook, and anything that slips stays where it was, marked, until you give it a new time.

PLAN THE DAY
• Add a task with a time and a length, or lock it so nothing moves it
• Push something 15, 30 or 60 minutes with one tap
• Anything pushed three times asks for a new slot instead of drifting
• See the week, the load on each day of the month, and the whole year

PLAN THE MEALS
• Put your own recipes on the day: breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner
• Calories and protein are calculated from what is actually in each recipe, raw or cooked
• The main meal is sized to reach the day's target, so a small recipe doesn't leave you short
• Tick a meal as eaten and the protein bar moves

PLAN THE SHOP
• The shopping list builds itself from the next few days of the meal plan
• In the raw weights a shop sells, even when a recipe is written in cooked weights
• Tick things off as you go round the shop

TARGETS THAT SHOW THEIR WORKING
Enter your height, weight and activity level and GetIt works out your calories, protein, fat and carbohydrate — and shows the arithmetic, so no number is a mystery.

WORKS WITHOUT A CONNECTION
Everything is on your phone. Tick things off in a basement gym or a shop with no signal; it syncs across your devices when you're back online.

REMINDERS
Optional reminders at each task's time, within a few minutes, with quiet hours. On a locked phone they show no text.

YOUR DATA
No advertising, no tracking, nothing sold or shared. Your data is stored in the EU. Export everything in one file, or delete your account from the app at any time.

GetIt is a planning tool. It does not give medical advice, and its calorie and protein targets are general estimates, not a prescription.
